title: 10 Best Leonurus Sibiricus Preparations

Teas made from dried leaves are commonly used to support circulation and reduce stress. Decoctions involve boiling the roots or leaves to extract potent compounds. Tinctures provide a concentrated form for quick absorption, while capsules offer a convenient and standardized dosage. Oils extracted from the plant are often used in topical applications for their soothing and healing properties.
